subject: Mutual Action: weekly owner rollcall + SOC 2 / pen test asks
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action: weekly owner rollcall + SOC 2 / pen test asks

Sara / Brian —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Per our MAP, I wanted to capture a short owner rollcall and immediate asks so we don’t lose momentum heading into contract review. Below is what we covered in the call and the owners we agreed on. Please reply with corrections if I misstated anything.

Summary (high level):
- SOC 2 evidence handoff: FinLedger will accept our spreadsheet of mapped evidence; Redwood will ingest the remaining items by EOW.
- Pen test scope: FinLedger provided target IP ranges and a proposed timeline; Redwood to confirm maintenance windows.
- Audit log retention question: FinLedger requested 12 months of immutable audit logs for API activity — Marissa to confirm feasibility and cost delta.

Action items (owners + ETA):
1) Finalize SOC 2 evidence spreadsheet (add missing artifacts + ownership column) — owner: Marissa Cole — ETA: 2027-04-12 EOD.
2) Confirm pen-test maintenance windows & sign-off on scope doc — owner: Rohan Mehta — ETA: 2027-04-13 11:00 PT.
3) Provide audit-log retention options + price delta (12m vs 6m) — owner: Karthik Iyer — ETA: 2027-04-14.
4) Share DocuSign contract stub for legal redlines (FinLedger) — owner: Sara Patel (FinLedger) — ETA: 2027-04-15.

Attachments I uploaded to the shared drive during the call: soc2-evidence-list.xlsx (work-in-progress), pen-test-scope.pdf (FinLedger draft). Link below.

Next sync: quick rollcall on Tue 2027-04-13 10:00 PT (15 minutes) — focused on open asks.

Thanks —
Rohan

Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.com

From: Sara Patel <sara@finledger.com>

Cc: Brian Lowe <brian@finledger.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action: weekly owner rollcall + SOC 2 / pen test asks

Rohan —

Thanks for the write-up and the quick call. Confirming the items look right from our side. A couple clarifications:
- Pen-test scope: we will run an external scan covering the two public endpoints listed in the scope doc and one authenticated test against the staging environment. We prefer the maintenance window on Apr 14 22:00–02:00 PT.
- Audit logs: the security team is explicit that 12 months immutable retention is preferred for compliance; can you provide a short note on how that will be implemented (KMS + write-once config) and the incremental cost?

I’ve asked Brian (cc) to start our internal legal review of the DocuSign stub — should have an initial pass by Apr 15.

Sara Patel
Head of Security Operations
FinLedger
sara@finledger.com
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@finledger.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action: weekly owner rollcall + SOC 2 / pen test asks

Sara —

Appreciate the maintenance window preference. I’ll tentatively book the Apr 14 evening window and confirm once Marissa and infra have validated the low-traffic slot.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm:
- Marissa: timeline to complete the evidence spreadsheet and whether you want us to upload PDFs to the drive or share as links in the spreadsheet.
- Karthik: quick feasibility on the 12m write-once audit logs and a rough cost delta (ballpark is fine for now).

I’ll leave this open for updates and will circulate updated attachments once Marissa’s sheet is refreshed.

-Rohan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara@finledger.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 13:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action: weekly owner rollcall + SOC 2 / pen test asks

All —

I updated soc2-evidence-list.xlsx and uploaded it to the shared folder (see link). Notes on the changes and open items below:

What I updated:
- Added ownership column (Redwood owner + point of contact email) for each artifact.
- Marked 6 artifacts as "missing" that require engineering help (deployment manifests, infra runbooks).
- Linked to existing GDrive PDFs where available; I can attach the remaining PDFs to the spreadsheet if you prefer.

Open items (from my side):
- Engineering owners for infra runbooks: @Karthik — can you assign two engineers who can pull the runbooks by Apr 12?
- Pen test maintenance window: Apr 14 22:00–02:00 PT looks acceptable but we should keep a 30-minute warm-up period prior to test start.
- Audit logs: I validated that 12-month immutable retention is technically feasible. We would implement using KMS-backed storage with an append-only policy and retention tags. I’ll work with Karthik on a cost estimate; expect a ballpark by Apr 14.

Action item recap (from the sheet):
- Marissa Cole — complete evidence mapping + attach missing PDFs — ETA 2027-04-12 EOD — (attachment: soc2-evidence-list.xlsx).
- Karthik Iyer — assign infra owners for runbooks & provide 12m vs 6m cost delta — ETA 2027-04-14.
- Rohan Mehta — confirm pen-test time with infra and update scope doc — ETA 2027-04-13.

I attached the current SOC 2 mapping as requested.

Thanks —
Marissa

Quick update from infra:
- I’ve assigned engineers Priya Natarajan and Vivek Kulkarni to pull the infra runbooks and deployment manifests. They will upload artifacts to the evidence folder by Apr 12.
- 12-month immutable audit logs: infra confirms feasible via KMS + object-level retention. Estimated monthly cost delta for FinchLedger-sized ingestion (~20GB/month) is approximately $450–650/month depending on encryption key residency. I’ll formalize this into a short note for Sara and include if/how we can expose tamper-evidence headers.

I’m reachable if the pen test team needs a quick pre-test checklist.

— Karthik
